caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know AI can make someone appear to say or do things they never did, so realistically it's hard to tell? 🤯

💡 Imagine a digital puppeteer that can take a person's voice and face, then make them perform any script or action in a video, indistinguishable from reality.
